items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Sidney Montague, he was a wonderful little drummer, but he never did do any tricks on the drum.

ctx.x: Was there any other drummers around here that you saw that had any tricks like that?
I didn't see anyone that had any tricks. Sidney Montague, he was a wonderful little drummer, but he never did do any tricks on the drum. He just always would play straight.
What about Black Benny? Did Black Benny have no tricks?
